content.content: The markers interface writes the file whole: the contents are written back by atomic replacement (S2-atomic, `rmmlokop`), a replacement never a truncate.
content.rationale: The whole-file read (S2-markers-read, `vupsskmp`) is what the write operates on; the whole-file save is the separate commitment about the write's form. The file is rewritten whole on every bracketed operation and every revert, so a write that left it half-written could destroy the record that makes undo and redo work. The marker file is written whole, never patched in place.
